item.title: Closer monitoring and new technology aim to limit badger-related rail issues
item.description: ProRail announced on Thursday that it expects “almost no sudden major repairs or prolonged train disruptions caused by badgers” in the future.

item.title: Dutch Gambling Authority targets social media "share your bet" feature
item.description: The Dutch Gambling Authority (Ksa) is targeting the practice of sharing bets on social media, citing concerns that such promotions can reach vulnerable audiences.

item.title: Man arrested for sharing Feyenoord director’s phone number online amid wave of threats
item.description: A 24-year-old man from The Hague was taken into custody on Thursday for publishing the mobile phone number of Feyenoord director Dennis te Kloese online.

item.title: Comedian Nadine Froughi's viral hits blend Dutch directness with her "outsider" view
item.description: Nadine Froughi describes herself as "spiritually" Dutch, yet her comedy thrives on the friction between her adopted home and her complex, international roots.

item.title: Amsterdam to open Walk of Pride honoring LGBTQIA+ heroes this summer
item.description: Amsterdam’s city center will get a Walk of Pride this summer, a walking route featuring special tiles bearing the names of heroes from the international LGBTQ+ community.

item.title: Dutch researchers working on nose spray that can prevent flu infections
item.description: Dutch and American scientists are working on a nasal spray containing a broad-spectrum antibody against influenza that is proving effective against a wide variety of strains.
